Summary: ESLint v9 flat config hangs under non-interactive PowerShell subprocesses
Reproduction_Steps: Run 'npm run lint' in frontend/ from non-interactive shell
Observed_Behavior: Subprocess hangs waiting on worker thread IPC
Recommended_Remediation: Add explicit files argument 'eslint src/' or rely on Next.js Turbopack typechecker

Summary: Default rate limit of 10 req/min throttles automated burst test harnesses
Reproduction_Steps: Run >10 upload/analyze requests in quick succession with same key
Recommended_Remediation: Configure RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS=100+ in automated test environments

Summary: In-memory JOB_STORE does not survive process restart
Reproduction_Steps: Restart backend process while a job is running or queued
Recommended_Remediation: In corporate/production deployments back job queue with Redis/Celery

Summary: Upstream model capacity 503 on browser automation subagent
Reproduction_Steps: Trigger complex browser subagent under peak API traffic
Recommended_Remediation: Use Playwright standalone headless script or local browser testing
